createProject.title: Create New Project
createProject.importFromGithub: Import an existing repository from GitHub to create a new project
createProject.importFromGitlab: Import an existing repository from GitLab to create a new project

step1.repoStepDescriptionGithub: Pick a GitHub repository to link to this project. The project name will be pre-filled from the repository.
step1.repoStepDescriptionGitlab: Pick a GitLab repository to link to this project. The project name will be pre-filled from the repository.
step1.notConnectedGithub: GitHub is not connected to this organization yet.
step1.notConnectedGitlab: GitLab is not connected to this organization yet.

step3.description: Describe your project so we can score vulnerabilities against the right business context. You can skip this step. Sensible defaults will apply and you can edit the context later in the project settings.

coach.intro: Pick how to add your project: import from GitHub/GitLab, or create it manually.
coach.basics: Name your project and pick its team.
coach.securityContext: Add security context so we score vulnerabilities right (or skip).
coach.success: 🎉 Project created! Copy this command to connect your AI agent.
